$\circ$ & 1 & Introduction to Binary Search & Classic search in a sorted array (Search Insert Position, Guess Number Higher or Lower) $\cdot$ First true: the predicate view (First Bad Version, Find Smallest Letter Greater Than Target) $\cdot$ Integer roots (Sqrt(x), Valid Perfect Square) \\

$\circ$ & 4 & Binary Search over Functions and Implicit Sequences & Implicit sequences (K-th Not Divisible by n, Maximum Number That Sum of the Prices Is Less Than or Equal to K) $\cdot$ Monotone functions of the answer (Building an Aquarium, Maximum Median) $\cdot$ Binary search on prefix sums (Worms, Random Pick with Weight) \\
$\circ$ & 5 & Binary Search on 2D Arrays & Sorted matrices (Search a 2D Matrix, Search a 2D Matrix II) $\cdot$ Counting and peaks in matrices (Count Negative Numbers in a Sorted Matrix, Find a Peak Element II) \\
